period of time whenever our internal resources are comfortable. 
 We have entered into an O&M agreement with the Arete Hospitals in Gachibowli, 
Hyderabad, which has a bed capacity of 300 beds.  
 
 We also entered into O&M agreement with Westfort Hospital in Thrissur, Kerala. It is an 
established and reputed hospital with a 300-bed capacity.

hold good potential and prospects.

investors. The latest acquisitions along with the recent expansions will ensure stable and 
sustainable growth of high range. 
 
Other Highlights 
                                                Making healthcare available and accessible has been our prime motto. In this connection, we are 
pleased to state that organ transplantations are performed across even tier two, tier three cities 
in entire Andhra Pradesh. All these years, transplantations involved long distances as they were 
performed only at a very few centers.It is no longer so, with all our units spread across the state

and child block that includes neonatal care facilities, support maternal, newborn, and pediatric 
services in the hospital. The new buildings and facilities were inaugurated on 1st November 
2026 by the Honorable Minister of Health and Honorable Minister of Finance, Government of

Ladies and gentlemen, good day and welcome to the Balkrishna Industries Limited Q2 and H1 
FY27 Earnings Conference Call. This conference call may contain forward-looking statements 
about the company, which are based on the beliefs, opinions, and expectations of the company 
as of date of this call. These statements are not guarantees of future performance and involve 
risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict. 
 
As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode, and there will be an 
opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance 
during the conference call, please signal for an operator by pressing star then zero on your 
touchtone phone. Please note that this conference is being recorded. 
 
I now hand the conference over to Mr. Rajiv Poddar, Joint Managing Director. Thank you, and 
over to you, sir. 
Rajiv Poddar: 
Thank you, Shaurya. Good morning, everyone, and thank you for joining us today. Along with 
me, I have Mr. Satish Sharma, Senior President and Director Strategy and Business 
Development, Mr. Saroj Khuntia, CFO, Mr. Sushil Mishra, Head of Accounts, and SGA, our IR 
Advisors. 
 
Let me begin with my remarks on the quarter's performance.  
End markets across the globe were extremely volatile due to evolving geopolitical situation. 
Despite this backdrop, we have delivered good sales volumes growth in quarter two. The 
profitability was impacted due to the headwinds caused by inflation in raw materials and freight 
costs. 
 
Going forward, we believe these headwinds will continue in the coming few quarters. We did 
take some price hikes. However, we could not fully pass through the cost price inflation.  
Similarly, in the Carbon Black business, we have continued to see raw material volatility led by 
higher crude prices.  
A key highlight for us was the recently announced tie-up with Pirelli for a strategic offtake 
agreement for the production of Pirelli-branded premium car tires in our facility in Bhuj. I would 
just like to add that in Phase 1, the production and sales is expected to start in the next calendar 
year, and we look forward to gradually ramping up the sales volume to 8 lakh tires - in year four, 
that is year 2030. This strategic tie-up not only fills our capacity but also strongly establishes 
our position as a commendable player in the Indian premium PCR market. 
 
The agreement further paves the way for a second phase in which there is an envisagement, at 
certain conditions, the creation of a 50-50 joint venture, and the construction of a production 
plant dedicated to high-value passenger car tires for both the brands, that is Pirelli brand as well 
as BKT brand, to serve India and other international markets for both the players. 
 
Let me start with the highlights of our OHT business.  

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Balkrishna Industries Limited 
 
 
November 05, 2026 
 
Page 3 of 9 
 
Our OHT business delivered good sales volume growth in Q2. The sales momentum was led by 
uptick in our end markets and segments. It is important to note that growth is not exactly 
comparable as last year Q2 was marred by very low sales from U.S. owing to Tariff situation. 
 
In Europe, we faced challenges due to extreme weather conditions and its related pressures on 
the agricultural market. Despite this, we have continued to build on the strong position we have 
created for the BKT brand in all major countries in the European market. India has continued to 
outperform We have seen positive trends across all micro markets in India despite erratic 
monsoons. In Americas, we witnessed stable sales. We are focusing on sharper execution to 
further increase our market share in this larger geography. 
 
One of the emerging growth levers for us in the OHT segment is the positive response from our 
end markets for the All-Steel Radial mining - range of tires. This is increasingly finding 
acceptance in the major mining markets across the world. 
 
I now invite Satish ji to share insights on the other two businesses. 
Satish Sharma: 
Good morning, everyone. I start first with the Carbon Black business.  
For quarter two FY27, our Carbon Black business recorded decent revenue growth on Y-on-Y 
basis, with third-party sales at around 10% of overall business. We are seeing robust demand for 
our range of products. Having completed all capex, we are firmly increasing our customer base. 
Further, we are initiating a roadmap for accelerated product development towards the better 
margin specialty blacks. 
 
Let me now move on to our on-road business.  
Our TBR and 2-wheeler range of tires has gained strong acceptance from both the channel as 
well as the end users, ensuring that we have a steep ramp-up of both production and sales. 
 
Further, in this portfolio, we are looking forward to the launch of PCR tires in the month of 
January '27. The recent tie-up with Pirelli has also evoked a very strong positive sentiment from 
our channel partners. 
 
With this summary, I now invite Saroj ji to share our operational and financial highlights. 
Saroj Khuntia: 
Hi, good morning, everyone. I will now share our operational and financial highlights.  
For H1, tire sales volume stood at 185,167 metric tons. Of this, the on-road portfolio contributed 
early single digit to the Q2 sales volume. Our standalone revenue for the quarter stood at 
INR3,450 crores, registering a growth of 49% year-on-year.This includes realized loss on 
foreign exchange pertaining to sales of INR 41 crores.  
For H1, standalone revenue stood at INR 6,859 crores, registering a growth of 35% year-on-
year. This includes realized loss on foreign exchange pertaining to sales of INR 76 crores. 
 
The standalone EBITDA for the quarter was at INR 629 crores with margin of 18.24%. The 
margin was particularly impacted on account of raw material prices due to global geopolitical 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Balkrishna Industries Limited 
 
 
November 05, 2026 
 
Page 4 of 9 
 
situation and its impact on supply chain. Further, India's contribution has increased to about 40% 
of overall volumes, which has also impacted margin slightly.  
For H1, EBITDA stood at INR 1,332 crores with a margin of 19.42%.  
Profit after tax stood for the quarter was recorded at INR  291 crores, while for H1 PAT was 
INR 723 crores.  
Our capex spend for H1 FY27 was approximately INR 1,850 crores. 
 
As on September 30, 2026, the gross debt and cash and cash equivalents were approximately 
INR 5,985 crores and INR 3,100 crores respectively. Accordingly, we have a net debt of 
approximately INR 2,887 crores.  
The euro rate for Q2 FY27 is around INR 103.  
The Board of Directors has recommended a second interim dividend of INR 4 per equity share 
in addition to INR 4 paid for Q1 FY27. 
 
I now hand over back to Mr. Poddar. 
Rajiv Poddar: 
Thank you. I would like to conclude by wishing all of you the best for the season's greetings. 
And with this, I conclude my opening remark and leave the floor open for Q&A. 
Moderator: 
Thank you very much. We will now begin with the question-and-answer session. The first

Raghunandhan NL: 
Congratulations, team, on strong volume performance and wishing a very Happy Diwali. My 
first question was on the volume trajectory. Extremely strong performance for two quarters, 
especially in a challenging environment.

of the year? Your thoughts specifically on low base of supporting U.S., and how do you see the 
growth ahead for Europe market share gains in America and continuation of growth in India? 
Can we expect that 90,000 metric ton per quarter run rate to continue? 
Rajiv Poddar: 
Good morning to you. Thank you for the question. While I cannot comment on any particular 
number, it will be our endeavor to hit those numbers, and that is what we are trying to do and 
maximize the sales and revenue growth. 
Raghunandhan NL: 
Noted, sir. My question next is on the on-road tires. Good to hear about the initial positive 
acceptance. On the on-road tires, is this part of the tire volume? There is this others portion of 
8,000 tons. Is on-road tires part of that? How much will be the on-road contribution be in that 
and how do you see this business revenue ramping up in FY27, 2028 and  also, is there a cost 
impact relating to on-road in our Q2 results? 
Rajiv Poddar: 
So yes, you are right. It is a part of that 8,000 tons. And as Satish-ji had mentioned in his opening 
remarks, it is a low single-digit volume. Of course, we expect this to continue to grow, and we 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Balkrishna Industries Limited 
 
 
November 05, 2026 
 
Page 5 of 9 
 
are following our Vision map 2030, where we have said that we would like 5% of the market 
share to come by 2030 and 20% of our turnover to come by this new vertical. That is what our 
endeavor is, and we are quite sure of meeting those vision. Thank you. 
Raghunandhan NL: 
Thank you, sir. Just a last question. On the Q2, how much was the commodity inflation impact, 
and what is the expectation for Q3? And also, what was the price taken in Q2 and the plan for

Rajiv Poddar: 
First part of the question, I cannot comment on this forum. The second part, we have tried to 
pass on a price increase of about 2%-3%, mainly from Indian market. Globally, we are looking

playing, and we are making a tactical play in this. That is what we are doing, and that we will

Raghunandhan NL: 
Thank you very much, sir. Wishing you all the best, and I will fall back to the queue.

As I mentioned in my opening remarks, the cost pressure will continue, and we are seeing it

Siddhartha Bera: 
Okay. Any further price hikes which we have sort of planning to take in the coming quarter to

be a tactical play between the two, which we will continue to do. 
Siddhartha Bera: 
Got it. On the other line items, freight cost, if you can share the number, because I would assume

for the year. Does it remain on track, or do you think there can be some increase to that? 
 Sushil Mishra: 
So regarding that freight cost, it is around 6.5% of the total sales value. Regarding -the capex, it

Siddhartha Bera: 
Okay, sir. Okay. Thanks a lot. I will fall back in the queue.

Arvind Sharma: 
Got it, sir. Just one clarification, if I may just ask. You talked about the contribution to volume

Rajiv Poddar: 
Single low digit.

I think you should look at it on a year-on-year basis. The growth has been substantial. Quarter- 
on- quarter also, the growth has been. I mean, the numbers are marginally off. It had longer 
supply chain issues and freight availability issues. I would not look at it on a quarter-on-quarter 
basis. There is definitely headwinds, and the situation is a little difficult, but we are trying to

Balkrishna Industries Limited 
 
 
November 05, 2026

Vijay Pandey: 
Okay. and the freight cost was, you mentioned 6.5% for quarter two, right? How -- do you see 
this to go up, and are we taking some price increases, or how should we look on this increase in

We estimate the sea freight to be at these levels, maybe marginal increase, but not a major one. 
We estimate it to be at these elevated levels. 
Vijay Pandey: 
And the higher freight cost is passed on through the higher ASP, or is it like… 
Rajiv Poddar: 
Not yet. 
Vijay Pandey: 
Okay. Okay. 
Vijay Pandey: 
Yes, just one more thing, sir. The RM cost per kg, just a follow-up on Raghu's question. The 
RM cost per kg has substantially increased. How do you see this thing to move forward, going 
forward because the commodity headwind continues to play, and our mix is also coming down.

Okay.

Black capacity. You mentioned that it's contributing 10% of the overall revenue. So, how is the

utilized. Regarding that third party, our endeavor is to increase our third-party sales. The newer

PCR, which is yet not launched. The dealer expansion is in tandem to the sales growth. So I

mean, the distribution ramp-up is again, you can say the response is very good and is in tandem

sir. If we X out the freight cost from the other expenses that you reported, there was a sharp

governance of accounting standards, we club it all in one quarter when we are making the 
payment.

side, because IPL happens?

disruption settle down, inventory level will also further come down.

November 05, 2026

Ladies and gentlemen, good day and welcome to the Balkrishna Industries Limited Q2 and H1 
FY27 Earnings Conference Call. This conference call may contain forward-looking statements 
about the company, which are based on the beliefs, opinions, and expectations of the company 
as of date of this call. These statements are not guarantees of future performance and involve 
risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict. 
 
As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode, and there will be an 
opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance 
during the conference call, please signal for an operator by pressing star then zero on your 
touchtone phone. Please note that this conference is being recorded. 
 
I now hand the conference over to Mr. Rajiv Poddar, Joint Managing Director. Thank you, and 
over to you, sir. 
Rajiv Poddar:

me, I have Mr. Satish Sharma, Senior President and Director Strategy and Business 
Development, Mr. Saroj Khuntia, CFO, Mr. Sushil Mishra, Head of Accounts, and SGA, our IR 
Advisors. 
 
Let me begin with my remarks on the quarter's performance.  
End markets across the globe were extremely volatile due to evolving geopolitical situation. 
Despite this backdrop, we have delivered good sales volumes growth in quarter two. The 
profitability was impacted due to the headwinds caused by inflation in raw materials and freight 
costs. 
 
Going forward, we believe these headwinds will continue in the coming few quarters. We did 
take some price hikes. However, we could not fully pass through the cost price inflation.  
Similarly, in the Carbon Black business, we have continued to see raw material volatility led by 
higher crude prices.  
A key highlight for us was the recently announced tie-up with Pirelli for a strategic offtake 
agreement for the production of Pirelli-branded premium car tires in our facility in Bhuj. I would 
just like to add that in Phase 1, the production and sales is expected to start in the next calendar 
year, and we look forward to gradually ramping up the sales volume to 8 lakh tires - in year four, 
that is year 2030. This strategic tie-up not only fills our capacity but also strongly establishes 
our position as a commendable player in the Indian premium PCR market. 
 
The agreement further paves the way for a second phase in which there is an envisagement, at 
certain conditions, the creation of a 50-50 joint venture, and the construction of a production 
plant dedicated to high-value passenger car tires for both the brands, that is Pirelli brand as well 
as BKT brand, to serve India and other international markets for both the players. 
 
Let me start with the highlights of our OHT business.

Our OHT business delivered good sales volume growth in Q2. The sales momentum was led by 
uptick in our end markets and segments. It is important to note that growth is not exactly 
comparable as last year Q2 was marred by very low sales from U.S. owing to Tariff situation. 
 
In Europe, we faced challenges due to extreme weather conditions and its related pressures on 
the agricultural market. Despite this, we have continued to build on the strong position we have 
created for the BKT brand in all major countries in the European market. India has continued to 
outperform We have seen positive trends across all micro markets in India despite erratic 
monsoons. In Americas, we witnessed stable sales. We are focusing on sharper execution to 
further increase our market share in this larger geography. 
 
One of the emerging growth levers for us in the OHT segment is the positive response from our 
end markets for the All-Steel Radial mining - range of tires. This is increasingly finding 
acceptance in the major mining markets across the world. 
 
I now invite Satish ji to share insights on the other two businesses. 
Satish Sharma:

For quarter two FY27, our Carbon Black business recorded decent revenue growth on Y-on-Y 
basis, with third-party sales at around 10% of overall business. We are seeing robust demand for 
our range of products. Having completed all capex, we are firmly increasing our customer base. 
Further, we are initiating a roadmap for accelerated product development towards the better 
margin specialty blacks. 
 
Let me now move on to our on-road business.  
Our TBR and 2-wheeler range of tires has gained strong acceptance from both the channel as 
well as the end users, ensuring that we have a steep ramp-up of both production and sales. 
 
Further, in this portfolio, we are looking forward to the launch of PCR tires in the month of 
January '27. The recent tie-up with Pirelli has also evoked a very strong positive sentiment from 
our channel partners. 
 
With this summary, I now invite Saroj ji to share our operational and financial highlights.

early single digit to the Q2 sales volume. Our standalone revenue for the quarter stood at 
INR3,450 crores, registering a growth of 49% year-on-year.This includes realized loss on 
foreign exchange pertaining to sales of INR 41 crores.  
For H1, standalone revenue stood at INR 6,859 crores, registering a growth of 35% year-on-
year. This includes realized loss on foreign exchange pertaining to sales of INR 76 crores. 
 
The standalone EBITDA for the quarter was at INR 629 crores with margin of 18.24%. The 
margin was particularly impacted on account of raw material prices due to global geopolitical

situation and its impact on supply chain. Further, India's contribution has increased to about 40% 
of overall volumes, which has also impacted margin slightly.  
For H1, EBITDA stood at INR 1,332 crores with a margin of 19.42%.  
Profit after tax stood for the quarter was recorded at INR  291 crores, while for H1 PAT was 
INR 723 crores.  
Our capex spend for H1 FY27 was approximately INR 1,850 crores. 
 
As on September 30, 2026, the gross debt and cash and cash equivalents were approximately

 PRESS RELEASE 
 
Cyient, 3-GIS Partner to Help Telecom and Utility Operators 
Turn Network Data into Operational Control 
Combines platform capabilities with CYiNGINE to help customers accelerate 
deployment and simplify long-term network management 
 
Hyderabad, November 11, 2026: Cyient Limited, a global Lifecycle Engineering Services 
company, and 3-GIS, a leading provider of network management software for telecom and 
utility networks, announced a strategic partnership under which Cyient will offer 3-GIS 
solutions alongside its engineering, implementation, migration, and managed services 
across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. 
As telecom operators accelerate fiber rollouts and utilities modernize critical infrastructure, 
the challenge is no longer collecting network data but keeping it accurate, connected, and 
actionable. Network information often resides across multiple systems, making planning, 
operations, compliance, and service delivery more complex. Traditionally, operators have 
had to engage separate providers for software platforms, deployment services, and 
operational intelligence. Through this partnership, Cyient and 3-GIS bring these capabilities 
together in a single integrated offering. 
With more than three decades of experience serving telecom and utility customers 
worldwide, Cyient has built deep expertise across geospatial, engineering, and digital 
services. The company has managed and transitioned over 650 million network data 
elements across large-scale programs, supporting fiber network design, GIS 
implementations, asset management, field operations, and network modernization 
initiatives. This experience will now be combined with the 3-GIS platform to help customers 
accelerate deployment, improve data quality, and simplify long-term network management. 
3-GIS provides cloud-native, configurable software that serves as a system of record for 
critical infrastructure networks. Telecom operators use the platform to manage fiber and 
copper network planning, design, inventory, construction, and operations, while electric and 
gas utilities leverage it for network management, asset inspection, field operations, and 
joint-use management. Together, Cyient and 3-GIS will enable customers to source both the 
platform and the services required to deploy and operate it through a single engagement 
model. 
 

 
 
   
As part of the partnership, Cyient will integrate 3-GIS with CYiNGINE, its Engineering 
Intelligence Platform, which combines domain expertise, governed data, and AI-driven 
playbooks across the engineering and service lifecycle. This integration will help customers 
derive greater value from network data while improving operational efficiency and decision-
making. 
 
“Whether it is a telecom operator expanding fiber with precision, or a utility trying to 
reconcile asset records, inspections and pole attachments across systems that do not talk to 
each other, the challenge is the same: the network record has to be accurate, or growth 
turns into rework and risk instead of revenue and reliability. By bringing the 3-GIS platform 
together with our engineering and managed services, we are giving operators across 
telecom, electric and gas one partner accountable for the whole journey, from migrating 
their data to running the network of record day to day, instead of stitching three vendors 
together and owning the gaps between them,” said Arunav Roy, SVP & Market Unit Head, 
Connectivity, Utilities & Spatial Intelligence, Cyient. 
 
“3-GIS has become a key part of how telecom and utility operators build and operate their 
critical networks globally. As we expand, it's important that we have a strong partner network 
to give customers in many markets options to work with their trusted partners to deliver, use, 
and support 3-GIS products. Cyient has been a valued partner for many years, and we're 
excited about this new strategic step in that partnership,” said Dustin Sutton, General 
Manager, 3-GIS. 
 
About Cyient 
Cyient is a global lifecycle engineering services company powering mission-critical industries 
from design to aftermarket across products, plants, and networks. With 300+ customers and 
19,000+ associates across 30+ countries, we combine human expertise, deep domain 
knowledge, and AI to deliver intelligent engineering for every lifecycle across Aerospace and 
Rail, Automotive and Mobility, Connectivity, Energy, Healthcare, Mining, Utilities, and 
beyond.   
To learn how we deliver exemplary outcomes, Nothing Less, visit www.cyient.com.  
Forward-Looking Statements 
Certain statements made in the press release that are not based on historical facts may be 
forward‑looking statements within the meaning of applicable laws and regulations. Such 
forward‑looking statements are subject to risks, uncertainties, and assumptions, like 
significant changes in the economic environment in India and overseas, regulatory and tax 
laws, import duties, litigation, labour relations and other factors beyond the Company’s 

 
 
   
control. Actual results may differ materially from those expressed or implied. 
 
Cyient undertakes no obligation to publicly update or revise these forward‑looking 
statements, whether as a result of new information, future events, or otherwise, except as 
required under applicable law. 
About 3-GIS 
The world’s critical networks run on 3-GIS, an enterprise software company that helps telecom, 
electric and gas organisations plan, design and manage increasingly complex networks. Our cloud-
native, fully configurable solutions turn network data into a trusted source of truth shared across the 
enterprise, from fibre planning and design to utility field operations, asset inventory, maintenance 
and modernisation. Purpose-built for telecom and utility operations, 3-GIS gives teams the visibility 
and confidence to make better decisions, reduce costs and automate service activation, so the 
people who connect and power the world can work faster, smarter and at greater scale. Learn more 
at www.3-gis.com or follow 3-GIS on LinkedIn.

 PRESS RELEASE 
 
Cyient, 3-GIS Partner to Help Telecom and Utility Operators 
Turn Network Data into Operational Control 
Combines platform capabilities with CYiNGINE to help customers accelerate 
deployment and simplify long-term network management 
 
Hyderabad, November 11, 2026: Cyient Limited, a global Lifecycle Engineering Services 
company, and 3-GIS, a leading provider of network management software for telecom and 
utility networks, announced a strategic partnership under which Cyient will offer 3-GIS 
solutions alongside its engineering, implementation, migration, and managed services 
across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. 
As telecom operators accelerate fiber rollouts and utilities modernize critical infrastructure, 
the challenge is no longer collecting network data but keeping it accurate, connected, and 
actionable. Network information often resides across multiple systems, making planning, 
operations, compliance, and service delivery more complex. Traditionally, operators have 
had to engage separate providers for software platforms, deployment services, and 
operational intelligence. Through this partnership, Cyient and 3-GIS bring these capabilities 
together in a single integrated offering. 
With more than three decades of experience serving telecom and utility customers 
worldwide, Cyient has built deep expertise across geospatial, engineering, and digital 
services. The company has managed and transitioned over 650 million network data 
elements across large-scale programs, supporting fiber network design, GIS 
implementations, asset management, field operations, and network modernization 
initiatives. This experience will now be combined with the 3-GIS platform to help customers 
accelerate deployment, improve data quality, and simplify long-term network management. 
3-GIS provides cloud-native, configurable software that serves as a system of record for 
critical infrastructure networks. Telecom operators use the platform to manage fiber and 
copper network planning, design, inventory, construction, and operations, while electric and 
gas utilities leverage it for network management, asset inspection, field operations, and 
joint-use management. Together, Cyient and 3-GIS will enable customers to source both the 
platform and the services required to deploy and operate it through a single engagement 
model. 
 

 
 
   
As part of the partnership, Cyient will integrate 3-GIS with CYiNGINE, its Engineering 
Intelligence Platform, which combines domain expertise, governed data, and AI-driven 
playbooks across the engineering and service lifecycle. This integration will help customers 
derive greater value from network data while improving operational efficiency and decision-
making. 
 
“Whether it is a telecom operator expanding fiber with precision, or a utility trying to 
reconcile asset records, inspections and pole attachments across systems that do not talk to 
each other, the challenge is the same: the network record has to be accurate, or growth 
turns into rework and risk instead of revenue and reliability. By bringing the 3-GIS platform 
together with our engineering and managed services, we are giving operators across 
telecom, electric and gas one partner accountable for the whole journey, from migrating 
their data to running the network of record day to day, instead of stitching three vendors 
together and owning the gaps between them,” said Arunav Roy, SVP & Market Unit Head, 
Connectivity, Utilities & Spatial Intelligence, Cyient. 
 
“3-GIS has become a key part of how telecom and utility operators build and operate their 
critical networks globally. As we expand, it's important that we have a strong partner network 
to give customers in many markets options to work with their trusted partners to deliver, use, 
and support 3-GIS products. Cyient has been a valued partner for many years, and we're 
excited about this new strategic step in that partnership,” said Dustin Sutton, General 
Manager, 3-GIS. 
 
About Cyient 
Cyient is a global lifecycle engineering services company powering mission-critical industries 
from design to aftermarket across products, plants, and networks. With 300+ customers and 
19,000+ associates across 30+ countries, we combine human expertise, deep domain 
knowledge, and AI to deliver intelligent engineering for every lifecycle across Aerospace and 
Rail, Automotive and Mobility, Connectivity, Energy, Healthcare, Mining, Utilities, and 
beyond.   
To learn how we deliver exemplary outcomes, Nothing Less, visit www.cyient.com.  
Forward-Looking Statements 
Certain statements made in the press release that are not based on historical facts may be 
forward‑looking statements within the meaning of applicable laws and regulations. Such 
forward‑looking statements are subject to risks, uncertainties, and assumptions, like 
significant changes in the economic environment in India and overseas, regulatory and tax 
laws, import duties, litigation, labour relations and other factors beyond the Company’s 

 
 
   
control. Actual results may differ materially from those expressed or implied. 
 
Cyient undertakes no obligation to publicly update or revise these forward‑looking 
statements, whether as a result of new information, future events, or otherwise, except as 
required under applicable law. 
About 3-GIS 
The world’s critical networks run on 3-GIS, an enterprise software company that helps telecom, 
electric and gas organisations plan, design and manage increasingly complex networks. Our cloud-
native, fully configurable solutions turn network data into a trusted source of truth shared across the 
enterprise, from fibre planning and design to utility field operations, asset inventory, maintenance 
and modernisation. Purpose-built for telecom and utility operations, 3-GIS gives teams the visibility 
and confidence to make better decisions, reduce costs and automate service activation, so the 
people who connect and power the world can work faster, smarter and at greater scale. Learn more 
at www.3-gis.com or follow 3-GIS on LinkedIn.

Moderator: 
Ladies and gentlemen, good day and welcome to the Poly Medicure Limited Q2 FY27 and Half 
Year FY27 Earnings conference Call. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-
only mode, and there will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation 
concludes. Should you need assistance during the conference call, please signal an operator by 
pressing star then zero on your touchtone phone. 
Today on this call, we have with us the senior management team of the company represented by 
Mr. Himanshu Baid, the Managing Director, Mr. Naresh Vijayvergiya, CFO, Mr. Rahul Gautam, 
President, Strategy and Corporate Development. 
I would now like to hand the conference over to Mr. Himanshu Baid. Thank you and over to 
you, sir. 
Himanshu Baid: 
Thank you very much. Good evening, everyone, and I welcome you all to Q2 and H1 FY27 
Earnings Call. I sincerely thank all of you for being here today. Before we get into the financial 
performance, I want to highlight few strategic updates since our last earning call. We are on 
track to optimize Medyneo, our subsidiary in Brazil. We had mentioned in our last call that Mr. 
Renato Rocha has joined as a CEO of the company, Polymed Brazil operations. 
We have also started dispatching our goods, first shipments to Brazil, the new subsidiary in 
October. This is a vital step for us to service our customers in Brazil, which is one of our key 
markets. We also established a direct presence in the U.K. This has been done to capture new 
opportunities under the India-UK FTA agreement. 
We are already working on three important projects. Hopefully, the first project will go live in 
quarter 1, the second one, the quarter 4 of this current financial year, the next one in quarter 1, 
and then the third one is anticipated in quarter 3 of the next financial year. So we have three 
important new projects going on other than what we are currently doing in the U.K. market. 
So, these are some important initiatives we have taken. We also see similar opportunities in other 
parts of Europe under India-EU trade agreement, which is going to be operationalized soon. So 
we are working on building some direct presence in some of the key markets in near future. So, 
these are some of the important initiatives I just wanted to call out early. 
Now on the financial performance summary, starting on our standalone performance, which 
remains the core for the group. For the half year, revenue was INR919 crores, up 15%, with 
domestic revenue of INR318 crores growing by almost 20%, international revenue of INR595 
crores growing around 12.5%. Gross profit was INR645 crores, up 17%, with a margin 
expanding by 111 basis points to 70.1%. 
Operating EBITDA was INR255 crores, up 20%, reflecting the operating leverage in the 
business. Profit after tax was INR180 crores. For the quarter, revenue was INR488 crores, up 
17%, with domestic revenue at INR172 crores growing 22%, and international revenue at 
INR313 crores growing at 15%. 

 
 
Poly Medicure Limited 
 
 
November 05, 2026 
 
Page 3 of 16 
 
Gross profit was INR336 crores, reflecting a gross margin of 68.9% with an absolute growth of 
16%. Operating EBITDA was INR134 crores with EBITDA margin of 27.4% with an absolute 
growth of 20%. PAT for the quarter was INR92 crores. 
Our domestic business continues a strong growth trajectory with a growth of 22% in quarter and 
more than 19% for the half year, broadly in the lines of our guidance of around 20% given in 
the beginning of the year. Taken together, we are seeing high growth across all verticals, not 
only our established verticals like infusion therapy and blood management, but also on the newer 
verticals. 
Our export business deserves a particular attention. International revenue grew by 15% in quarter 
2 versus 10% in quarter 1, reflecting improving growth trajectory. Export revenue grew by 
12.5% for the half year, once we add up the two quarters. We are confident that the revenue 
recovery that we had spoken about earlier showing up consistency in the numbers. 
In international markets, we have added 30 new customers in last six months, deepened 
relationship with existing customers by increasing our share of revenue and cross-selling new 
products to them. On the gross profit front, our gross margins increased by 111 basis points to 
70.1% in H1, with a gross profit growing around 17%. 
As you may recall that in the beginning of the year, we had guided for an impact of 200 to 300 
basis points in gross margin due to increase in raw material prices on account of ongoing West 
Asia crisis. We have effectively mitigated that risk by proactively managing inventory, taking 
calibrated price hikes, and focusing on selling high-value products. We reported a PAT of 
INR180 crores in H1, reflecting a margin of 18.6%. For Q2, the PAT was INR92 crores, 
reflecting a margin of 18.1%. 
Coming on the consolidated picture for the half year, revenue was INR1,106 crores, up 31%. 
Excluding the impact of acquisition, organic consolidated revenue grew by 14%, led to 
continuous strong growth in India and Europe, which grew by 19% and 29%, respectively.  
Gross profit was INR793 crores, up 36%. The margin expanding by 270 basis points to 71.7% 
as the better margin profile of acquired businesses and greater contribution in higher value-added 
products continue to lift group's gross margin. Operating EBITDA was INR266 crores, up 19%. 
Profit after tax was INR180 crores on H1 basis. 
It is important to know that H1 operating EBITDA of INR266 crores also absorbs the set-up cost 
for our new U.K. and Brazil subsidiaries. For the quarter, consolidated revenue was INR581 
crores, up 31%. Gross profit was INR407 crores, up 32%. Operating EBITDA was INR139 
crores, up 20%. PAT, our profit after tax was INR95 crores. 
Let me give you a quick update on each of the business segments. Infusion therapy grew 11% 
to INR542 crores in H1, 12% to INR284 crores in Q2, with domestic growing in this segment 
20% both in H1 and Q2. Orthopaedics contributed to INR92 crores in H1 and INR43 crores in 
Q2, reflecting consolidation at Citieffe. 

 
 
Poly Medicure Limited 
 
 
November 05, 2026 
 
Page 4 of 16 
 
Renal business recovered well, growing 7.5% to INR94 crores in H1 and 20% to INR51 crores 
in Q2. Despite the continued dumping from Chinese players, our dialysis machine business 
continues to scale. We have cumulatively sold now approximately 1250 machines till date. 
We are still waiting for the results of the anti-dumping case which we have filed, which was 
filed in end of June. It has been four months we have been pursuing with the government, and I 
think we are seeing some movement there. Hopefully, in few months, we should be able to see 
some action from the government on this issue. 
Cardiology revenue was INR56 crores in H1 and INR27 crores in Q2, led by PendraCare 
acquisition. Clinical deployment is improving month on month. As in October, we have 
implanted close to 18,000 drug-eluting stents. Our 2,000 patient PACIFIER DES clinical 
registry has enrolled 1,150 patients, with full enrollment targeted by end of FY27. 
We have also launched the IVL, a minimally invasive technology that uses sonic pressure waves 
to break up calcium in heavily calcified arteries. This new product launch was done in August 
in current financial year, and hopefully we will see the revenue taking up from this business also 
shortly. The other segments grew 23% to INR317 crores in H1 and 26% to INR173 crores in 
Q2, with broad-based growth across critical care, transfusion system, et cetera. Liquidity 
position and capex. 
Turning to our balance sheet, our liquidity remains strong at INR839 crores as on September 30 
against consolidated debt of INR377 crores, net cash position of INR460 crores. This gives us 
capacity to keep backing our strategic growth and growth-oriented initiatives. We spent INR124 
crores on capex in first half of our annual guidance of INR200 crore-INR225 crores.  
Out of this, INR124 crores in India business and INR15 crores in overseas businesses. Forward-
looking guidance. Now, let me connect to our forward-looking guidance for FY27. We are 
reaffirming the guidance we have shared previously. Importantly, based on our Q2 performance, 
our annualized revenue run rate is already close to what is required to achieve our full-year 
guidance. 
On a consolidated basis, we maintain revenue guidance of INR2,300 crore-INR2,400 crores. On 
a standalone basis, INR1,900 crore-INR1,950 crores, with domestic growing 20% and 
international growing 15%. We are increasing our standalone EBITDA margin guidance from 
25%-27% to 26%-27.5% for FY27 on improved performance. For consolidated business, we are 
maintaining our EBITDA guidance of 23%-25%. Our capex guidance also remains the same 
between INR200 crores-225 crores. 
In summary, H1 and Q2 FY27 numbers have reaffirmed the fundamental strength of our business 
model, diversity of our business across regions, customers, therapies that has ensured our 
business continues to grow despite geopolitical challenges. Our ability to improve EBITDA 
margin despite headwinds of raw material price, freight cost increase reflects the inherent 
resilience of the business and its pricing power. 
Strong comeback in European business for us in this year reflects strongly on our brand presence 
in that core market. This is extremely important given Europe is a core part of our business. I 

 
 
Poly Medicure Limited 
 
 
November 05, 2026

remain extremely confident about the future potential of our business. We are aggressively 
working to go beyond the vision of doubling the revenue we have set for ourselves under 
Polymed 3.0. Again, thank you very much for your trust and your time. 
I now hand over to the operator, and we will be happy to take your questions. Thanks again.

track to optimize Medyneo, our subsidiary in Brazil. We had mentioned in our last call that Mr.

crores growing around 12.5%. Gross profit was INR645 crores, up 17%, with a margin 
expanding by 111 basis points to 70.1%.

INR313 crores growing at 15%.

only our established verticals like infusion therapy and blood management, but also on the newer

Moderator: 
Ladies and gentlemen, good day, and welcome to the Minda Corporation 
Limited Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call hosted by Emkay Global 
Financial Services Limited. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the 
listen-only mode and there will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after 
the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance during the conference 
call, please signal an operator by pressing star then zero on your touch-tone 
phone. 
 
Please note that this conference is being recorded. I now hand the conference 
over to Mr. Chirag Jain from Emkay Global Financial Services Limited. Thank 
you, and over to you, sir. 
Chirag Jain: 
Thank you, Shruti. Good evening, everyone. On behalf of Emkay Global 
Financial Services, I would like to welcome you all to the Q2 FY27 Earnings 
Conference Call of Minda Corporation. From the management team, we have 
with us today, Mr. Aakash Minda, Executive Director; Mr. Ajay Agarwal, 
Group CFO and President, Finance and Strategy; and Mr. Nitesh Jain, Lead 
Investor Relations. I shall now hand over the call to the management for 
opening remarks, post which we will open the floor for Q&A. Over to you, sir. 
Aakash Minda: 
Thank you, Chirag and Emkay, for hosting this call. Good afternoon, everyone, 
and welcome to the Q2 and H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call of Minda 
Corporation Limited. 
 
I am Aakash Minda, Executive Director, Minda Corporation. I hope all of you 
are doing well. It is a pleasure to connect with you today to discuss the 
company's performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 
2026, and share the key developments across our businesses. I will begin with 
a brief overview of the macroeconomic environment and the automotive 
industry. 
 
Mr. Ajay Agarwal will then take you through our financial and operational 
performance for the quarter, after which we will be happy to take on your 
questions. The global environment continues to present uncertainty around 
trade and geopolitical developments. Against this backdrop, the Indian 
automotive industry recorded its highest ever second quarter sales across 
vehicle segments. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Minda Corporation Limited 
 
November 03, 2026 
Page 3 of 16 
 
 
Improved affordability following GST changes, festive purchase and 
infrastructure activity supported the demand. These conditions provide 
opportunities for automotive components manufacturers while increasing 
customer expectations on technology, quality and delivery continue to shape 
business priorities. Turning to individual segments. The 2-wheeler segment 
grew by approximately 16.5%, driven by strong scooter demand and export 
momentum. 
 
Demand for 2-wheeler benefited from increased scooter sales and record 
second quarter exports. Passenger vehicles grew by approximately 25%, led 
by strong demand for utility vehicles, premiumization and exports. Passenger 
vehicles benefited from improved affordability and sustained rural demand. 3-
wheelers recorded growth of approximately 24% due to increasing 
requirements for last-mile mobility and cargo transportation. 
 
Commercial vehicles grew by approximately 34% during the quarter, gained 
from infrastructure spending, freight movement and exports, while tractors 
benefited from favorable agriculture activity and purchases ahead of the festive 
season. Overall, demand conditions remain positive across the major vehicle 
segments. 
 
Now coming to Minda Corporation. During the Q2 FY27, the company 
surpassed consensus estimates, delivering its highest ever quarterly revenue of 
INR 2,189 crores with a growth of 43% on a year-on-year basis. The company 
reported EBITDA of INR 257 crores with a growth of approximately 45% on 
a year-on-year basis, along with an EBITDA margin of 11.8%. PAT reached 
INR 143 crores with a growth of 69% on a year-on-year basis. 
 
Minda Corporation delivered a landmark quarter, achieving strong 
performance across revenue, EBITDA and profit. The company surpassed the 
INR 2,000 crores quarterly revenue milestone for the first time, reflecting the 
strength of its expanding product portfolio and increasing participation across 
vehicle segments. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations was INR 4,036 
crores with a growth of 38% on a year-on-year basis. EBITDA reached INR 
469 crores with a margin of 11.6% and a profit after tax was INR 243 crores. 
 
The first half also marked progress in bringing new products into production 
and securing customer programs that will support the growth over the coming 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Minda Corporation Limited 
 
November 03, 2026 
Page 4 of 16 
 
years. On the company's associate company, Flash Electronics, Flash has 
continued to deliver strong performance during the quarter with revenues of 
INR 650 crores in Q2 with an EBITDA of INR 106 crores and an EBITDA 
margin of 16.4%. 
 
During the quarter, margins were affected by 3 key factors: elevated 
commodity pricing, increased input costs, although these increases are largely 
pass-through in nature with recovery from customers expected over the coming 
quarter. Revision in minimum wages across several states added to our labour 
cost. 
 
Prevailing market conditions resulted in higher freight expenses. On the new 
business front, the company secured multiple orders on TFT instrument cluster 
businesses ranging from 5 to 12-inch with a cumulative lifetime value 
exceeding INR 1,000 crores across segments of 2-wheeler, 3-wheeler, 
commercial vehicle and most importantly, passenger vehicle and platform 
products. Production is planned to commence in FY28 and onwards. This win 
expands our presence in digital driver information systems and demonstrates 
customer acceptance of our capabilities in advanced electronics. 
 
The company also won multiple orders in electric vehicle mobility and a 
notable order from a 3-wheeler OEM for the 3.5 kilowatt charger with 
production planned for the first quarter in next financial year. EV products 
accounted for approximately 35% of new order wins during the quarter. On the 
technology front, the company continues to strengthen its capability through 
strategic partnerships and new program products. 
 
During the year, the company also received approval from the Government of 
India on ECMS initiative for localization of display module assembly for 
automotive sector. In parallel, the SOPs for advanced switches business and 
other new programs are progressing as planned, further expanding the 
company's product offerings across new age automobile technologies. The 
company's performance continues to be guided by following key pillars of 
growth, which are: one, investment in existing businesses; two, exports-led 
growth; three, premiumization of existing products; fourth, new product 
launches; fifth, new customers and increased penetration in existing customers; 
sixth, investment into our R&D capability. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Minda Corporation Limited 
 
November 03, 2026 
Page 5 of 16 
 
 
Looking ahead, the company remains committed to executing its strategic 
priorities with continued focus on enhancing its system solution offering, 
strengthening customer relationships and investing in new technologies. The 
company remains focused on disciplined capital allocation, expanding its 
presence in high-growth segments and advancing its R&D capabilities that will 
drive long-term value creation for all stakeholders. With that, I would like to 
invite Mr. Ajay Agarwal, , to take you through the detailed financial 
performance and key highlights for the quarter. Over to you, Ajay.

Thank you, Aakash. Once again, a very good afternoon to all of you. The 
presentation and the slides have already been uploaded. I'm assuming all of 
you would have had the opportunity to go through that. 
 
So I'll briefly touch upon some of the key highlights about the company and 
about the performance during Q2 and not necessarily go through each and 
every slides. So as we all know, Minda has been in the automotive industry 
and has been serving the industry for the last 6 decades, and we have presence 
across India and some of the Asian countries as well. 
 
Our operating base today includes 42 manufacturing plants with a workforce 
of more than 23,000 and we are, as we speak, in the process of building around 
6 to 7 more plants, which will commence operations in the next 12 to 24 
months time. From an expansion and a growth perspective, we have close to 
about 8.2 lakh square meter land bank. And upon that, the built-up space is 
about 2.6 lakh square meters. So it gives us a huge headroom to develop our 
strategy for growth. 
 
Our engineering capabilities includes 1,000 engineers with more than 340 
patents. Out of that, 155 have been granted with 2 advanced technology centers 
and 7 engineering centers. Moving to Slide number 4. As Aakash briefly 
touched upon, it has been a landmark quarter for Minda Corporation across all 
parameters. We achieved our highest quarterly revenue and EBITDA. Revenue 
grew by about 43% year-on-year, significantly ahead of approximately 18% 
industry growth with an EBITDA margin of 11.8%. Particularly, as we all 
know, the company has been focusing extremely on its EV portfolio and 
product. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Minda Corporation Limited 
 
November 03, 2026 
Page 6 of 16 
 
 
The EV product revenue grew by 113% year-on-year, contributing 10% of 
Minda Corporation's revenue and 15% at a group level. 
 
EV product now represents close to about 35% of our order book value. We 
secured TFT display order with a lifetime value exceeding INR 1,000 crores 
with production planned to commence in financial year 2028. Sunroof also 
started production during this quarter, and we have secured our first power 
footstep order also from one of the anchor passenger vehicle customers. 
 
Alongside of these financial performances, our credit rating has also improved 
from AA- to AA. Moving to Slide number 5. Our 100% subsidiary, Minda 
Instruments received government approval to manufacture display modules, 
subassembly under the ECMS scheme, and it will take anywhere between 12 
to 18 months time for the plant to come up. 
 
This is a proposed greenfield TFT display module assembly facility and it 
forms part of our backward integration strategy. This facility is intended to 
bring display component in-house and replace significant part of imports, 
which currently the company is doing. Moving to Slide number 6. Our Q2 
revenue reached INR 2,189 crores, up 43% year-on-year and 19% sequentially. 
EBITDA reached INR 257 crores, up 45% year-on-year and 22% sequentially 
with a margin standing at 11.8%.

PAT margin also reached 6.5% and is one of the best PAT delivery, which has

with EBITDA at INR 469 crores and EBITDA margin at 11.6% for 6 months. 
Half year normalized PAT stood at INR 243 crores with a margin of 6%. 
 
This excludes INR 106 crores exceptional gain net of tax arising from Minda 
VAST consolidation, which happened in Q1 of this fiscal year. From a revenue 
mix perspective, wiring harness contributed about 31% of quarterly revenue, 
followed by vehicle access 24%. Die casting and cluster and other products 
contributed about 15% of our revenue base. 
 
From an export perspective, Europe and North America contributed about 6%, 
South Asia contributed 5% and 89% revenue came from India business. I'll 
briefly touch on Flash Electronics performance. Flash delivered Q2 revenue of 
INR 650 crores, EBITDA at INR 106 crores with PAT stand at INR 54 crores.

November 03, 2026

a half yearly basis, the revenue stood at INR 1,183 crores, EBITDA at INR 188 
crores and PAT at INR 89 crores. For Flash Electronics, the EV products

Limited Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference Call hosted by Emkay Global

Chirag Jain: 
Thank you, Shruti. Good evening, everyone. On behalf of Emkay Global 
Financial Services, I would like to welcome you all to the Q2 FY27 Earnings 
Conference Call of Minda Corporation. From the management team, we have 
with us today, Mr. Aakash Minda, Executive Director; Mr. Ajay Agarwal, 
Group CFO and President, Finance and Strategy; and Mr. Nitesh Jain, Lead 
Investor Relations. I shall now hand over the call to the management for 
opening remarks, post which we will open the floor for Q&A. Over to you, sir. 
Aakash Minda: 
Thank you, Chirag and Emkay, for hosting this call. Good afternoon, everyone, 
and welcome to the Q2 and H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call of Minda 
Corporation Limited. 
 
I am Aakash Minda, Executive Director, Minda Corporation. I hope all of you 
are doing well. It is a pleasure to connect with you today to discuss the 
company's performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 
2026, and share the key developments across our businesses. I will begin with 
a brief overview of the macroeconomic environment and the automotive 
industry. 
 
Mr. Ajay Agarwal will then take you through our financial and operational 
performance for the quarter, after which we will be happy to take on your 
questions. The global environment continues to present uncertainty around 
trade and geopolitical developments. Against this backdrop, the Indian 
automotive industry recorded its highest ever second quarter sales across 
vehicle segments. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Minda Corporation Limited 
 
November 03, 2026 
Page 3 of 16 
 
 
Improved affordability following GST changes, festive purchase and 
infrastructure activity supported the demand. These conditions provide 
opportunities for automotive components manufacturers while increasing 
customer expectations on technology, quality and delivery continue to shape 
business priorities. Turning to individual segments. The 2-wheeler segment 
grew by approximately 16.5%, driven by strong scooter demand and export 
momentum. 
 
Demand for 2-wheeler benefited from increased scooter sales and record 
second quarter exports. Passenger vehicles grew by approximately 25%, led 
by strong demand for utility vehicles, premiumization and exports. Passenger 
vehicles benefited from improved affordability and sustained rural demand. 3-
wheelers recorded growth of approximately 24% due to increasing 
requirements for last-mile mobility and cargo transportation. 
 
Commercial vehicles grew by approximately 34% during the quarter, gained 
from infrastructure spending, freight movement and exports, while tractors 
benefited from favorable agriculture activity and purchases ahead of the festive 
season. Overall, demand conditions remain positive across the major vehicle 
segments. 
 
Now coming to Minda Corporation. During the Q2 FY27, the company 
surpassed consensus estimates, delivering its highest ever quarterly revenue of 
INR 2,189 crores with a growth of 43% on a year-on-year basis. The company 
reported EBITDA of INR 257 crores with a growth of approximately 45% on 
a year-on-year basis, along with an EBITDA margin of 11.8%. PAT reached 
INR 143 crores with a growth of 69% on a year-on-year basis. 
 
Minda Corporation delivered a landmark quarter, achieving strong 
performance across revenue, EBITDA and profit. The company surpassed the 
INR 2,000 crores quarterly revenue milestone for the first time, reflecting the 
strength of its expanding product portfolio and increasing participation across 
vehicle segments. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations was INR 4,036 
crores with a growth of 38% on a year-on-year basis. EBITDA reached INR 
469 crores with a margin of 11.6% and a profit after tax was INR 243 crores. 
 
The first half also marked progress in bringing new products into production 
and securing customer programs that will support the growth over the coming 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Minda Corporation Limited 
 
November 03, 2026 
Page 4 of 16 
 
years. On the company's associate company, Flash Electronics, Flash has 
continued to deliver strong performance during the quarter with revenues of 
INR 650 crores in Q2 with an EBITDA of INR 106 crores and an EBITDA 
margin of 16.4%. 
 
During the quarter, margins were affected by 3 key factors: elevated 
commodity pricing, increased input costs, although these increases are largely 
pass-through in nature with recovery from customers expected over the coming 
quarter. Revision in minimum wages across several states added to our labour 
cost. 
 
Prevailing market conditions resulted in higher freight expenses. On the new 
business front, the company secured multiple orders on TFT instrument cluster 
businesses ranging from 5 to 12-inch with a cumulative lifetime value 
exceeding INR 1,000 crores across segments of 2-wheeler, 3-wheeler, 
commercial vehicle and most importantly, passenger vehicle and platform 
products. Production is planned to commence in FY28 and onwards. This win 
expands our presence in digital driver information systems and demonstrates 
customer acceptance of our capabilities in advanced electronics. 
 
The company also won multiple orders in electric vehicle mobility and a 
notable order from a 3-wheeler OEM for the 3.5 kilowatt charger with 
production planned for the first quarter in next financial year. EV products 
accounted for approximately 35% of new order wins during the quarter. On the 
technology front, the company continues to strengthen its capability through 
strategic partnerships and new program products. 
 
During the year, the company also received approval from the Government of 
India on ECMS initiative for localization of display module assembly for 
automotive sector. In parallel, the SOPs for advanced switches business and 
other new programs are progressing as planned, further expanding the 
company's product offerings across new age automobile technologies. The 
company's performance continues to be guided by following key pillars of 
growth, which are: one, investment in existing businesses; two, exports-led 
growth; three, premiumization of existing products; fourth, new product 
launches; fifth, new customers and increased penetration in existing customers; 
sixth, investment into our R&D capability. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Minda Corporation Limited 
 
November 03, 2026 
Page 5 of 16 
 
 
Looking ahead, the company remains committed to executing its strategic 
priorities with continued focus on enhancing its system solution offering, 
strengthening customer relationships and investing in new technologies. The 
company remains focused on disciplined capital allocation, expanding its 
presence in high-growth segments and advancing its R&D capabilities that will 
drive long-term value creation for all stakeholders. With that, I would like to 
invite Mr. Ajay Agarwal, , to take you through the detailed financial 
performance and key highlights for the quarter. Over to you, Ajay.

Thank you, Aakash. Once again, a very good afternoon to all of you. The 
presentation and the slides have already been uploaded. I'm assuming all of 
you would have had the opportunity to go through that. 
 
So I'll briefly touch upon some of the key highlights about the company and 
about the performance during Q2 and not necessarily go through each and 
every slides. So as we all know, Minda has been in the automotive industry 
and has been serving the industry for the last 6 decades, and we have presence

IntellectAI Launches Xponent Portfolio Navigator, Letting Insurers 
Steer Their Entire Book Instead of Just Reporting on It 
 
New AI application lets carriers, MGAs and reinsurers spot portfolio drift, test each quote's impact before 
binding, and act on one policy or 30,000 in a single step 
 
Piscataway, NJ, November 11, 2026: IntellectAI, the Insurtech business unit of Intellect Design Arena 
Ltd., today launched Xponent Portfolio Navigator (XPN), an AI portfolio steering application for 
commercial and specialty (Re)Insurers. It shows carriers, MGAs, and reinsurers all key metrics that drive 
P&L and risk, where their book is drifting and lets them reprice, refer, or non-renew that business from 
the same screen. 
 
Portfolio performance is decided across the whole book, yet most insurers still act on it one file at a 
time. Finding a problem typically means running a business intelligence (BI) report, pulling detail from 
source systems, then acting in a separate tool. By the time they act, the problem has often already 
shown up as losses. 
 
XPN closes that gap by combining portfolio analytics, in-context AI, and underwriting workflow in one 
application. Every number traces back to the underlying policies, quotes, and claims. Every decision can 
be routed to agentic workflows, referral underwriters, managers, or the portfolio committee. 
 
Xponent Portfolio Navigator is built on Purple Fabric, Intellect’s governed AI platform. Insurers decide, 
action by action, whether AI agents handle the work or a person reviews it, set the limits for automation, 
and keep a full audit trail of every decision. It joins a growing IntellectAI platform that includes MSOCK, 
the company’s system of connected knowledge, which lets carriers buy turnkey products like Xponent or 
build their own on the same foundation. 
 
“Commercial and specialty insurers are being asked to grow profitably in a market that 
keeps shifting under them,” said Banesh Prabhu, CEO, IntellectAI. “Xponent Portfolio 
Navigator gives their underwriting leaders a live view of the whole book and the ability to 
act on it right away. That’s how portfolio steering becomes a daily discipline instead of a 
quarterly report.” 
 
"Insurers don't lack portfolio data. They lack a fast way to act on it," said Sandeep 
Haridas, EVP and Insurance Business Head, IntellectAI. “XPN lets an underwriting 
leader find drift, size the fix, and set it in motion in one sitting, whether that's one 
policy or an entire segment." 
 
Xponent Portfolio Navigator is available now in two ways. Insurers can add it to 
Intellect Xponent, IntellectAI's underwriting workbench, where portfolio steering sits alongside risk-level 
underwriting in a single view. Or they can buy it on its own and connect it through APIs to the policy 
administration, claims, and data warehouse systems they already run. 
 

 
 
About Intellect Design Arena Limited 
Intellect Design Arena Ltd is a global leader in AI-First, enterprise-grade financial technology, architected from first 
principles to deliver measurable business impact at scale. With three decades of domain expertise, Intellect 
delivers composable, intelligent platforms across Wholesale Banking, Consumer Banking, Central Banking, Wealth, 
Capital Markets, Treasury, Insurance and Digital Technology for Commerce. Applying First Principles Thinking and 
Design Thinking, Intellect has elementalized financial services into a finite set of Events, Microservices and APIs, 
enabling faster, modular transformation with predictable and measurable outcomes. 
 
At the heart of this AI-First architecture are eMACH.ai, the world’s most comprehensive, composable and 
intelligent open finance platform; Purple Fabric, the world’s first Open Business Impact AI platform; and iTurmeric, 
a composable integration and configuration platform. A pioneer in applying Design Thinking at enterprise scale, 
Intellect’s 8012 FinTech Design Center™, the world’s first Design Center dedicated to Design Thinking principles, 
underscores its commitment to continuous, outcome-driven innovation. Intellect serves over 500+ customers 
across 62 countries, supported by a global workforce of domain, solution and technology experts. For more 
information about Intellect, visit https://www.intellectdesign.com/ 
 
About IntellectAI 
IntellectAI is an Insurtech Transformation Partner with contemporary AI and ML solutions, data insights 
triangulated from thousands of sources, and agile technology, data science, and consulting teams that take a 
strategic approach to tackling the biggest challenges for the industry. https://www.intellectai.com

IntellectAI Launches Xponent Portfolio Navigator, Letting Insurers 
Steer Their Entire Book Instead of Just Reporting on It 
 
New AI application lets carriers, MGAs and reinsurers spot portfolio drift, test each quote's impact before 
binding, and act on one policy or 30,000 in a single step 
 
Piscataway, NJ, November 11, 2026: IntellectAI, the Insurtech business unit of Intellect Design Arena 
Ltd., today launched Xponent Portfolio Navigator (XPN), an AI portfolio steering application for 
commercial and specialty (Re)Insurers. It shows carriers, MGAs, and reinsurers all key metrics that drive 
P&L and risk, where their book is drifting and lets them reprice, refer, or non-renew that business from 
the same screen. 
 
Portfolio performance is decided across the whole book, yet most insurers still act on it one file at a 
time. Finding a problem typically means running a business intelligence (BI) report, pulling detail from 
source systems, then acting in a separate tool. By the time they act, the problem has often already 
shown up as losses. 
 
XPN closes that gap by combining portfolio analytics, in-context AI, and underwriting workflow in one 
application. Every number traces back to the underlying policies, quotes, and claims. Every decision can 
be routed to agentic workflows, referral underwriters, managers, or the portfolio committee. 
 
Xponent Portfolio Navigator is built on Purple Fabric, Intellect’s governed AI platform. Insurers decide, 
action by action, whether AI agents handle the work or a person reviews it, set the limits for automation, 
and keep a full audit trail of every decision. It joins a growing IntellectAI platform that includes MSOCK, 
the company’s system of connected knowledge, which lets carriers buy turnkey products like Xponent or 
build their own on the same foundation. 
 
“Commercial and specialty insurers are being asked to grow profitably in a market that 
keeps shifting under them,” said Banesh Prabhu, CEO, IntellectAI. “Xponent Portfolio 
Navigator gives their underwriting leaders a live view of the whole book and the ability to 
act on it right away. That’s how portfolio steering becomes a daily discipline instead of a 
quarterly report.” 
 
"Insurers don't lack portfolio data. They lack a fast way to act on it," said Sandeep 
Haridas, EVP and Insurance Business Head, IntellectAI. “XPN lets an underwriting 
leader find drift, size the fix, and set it in motion in one sitting, whether that's one 
policy or an entire segment." 
 
Xponent Portfolio Navigator is available now in two ways. Insurers can add it to 
Intellect Xponent, IntellectAI's underwriting workbench, where portfolio steering sits alongside risk-level 
underwriting in a single view. Or they can buy it on its own and connect it through APIs to the policy 
administration, claims, and data warehouse systems they already run. 
 

 
 
About Intellect Design Arena Limited 
Intellect Design Arena Ltd is a global leader in AI-First, enterprise-grade financial technology, architected from first 
principles to deliver measurable business impact at scale. With three decades of domain expertise, Intellect 
delivers composable, intelligent platforms across Wholesale Banking, Consumer Banking, Central Banking, Wealth, 
Capital Markets, Treasury, Insurance and Digital Technology for Commerce. Applying First Principles Thinking and 
Design Thinking, Intellect has elementalized financial services into a finite set of Events, Microservices and APIs, 
enabling faster, modular transformation with predictable and measurable outcomes. 
 
At the heart of this AI-First architecture are eMACH.ai, the world’s most comprehensive, composable and 
intelligent open finance platform; Purple Fabric, the world’s first Open Business Impact AI platform; and iTurmeric, 
a composable integration and configuration platform. A pioneer in applying Design Thinking at enterprise scale, 
Intellect’s 8012 FinTech Design Center™, the world’s first Design Center dedicated to Design Thinking principles, 
underscores its commitment to continuous, outcome-driven innovation. Intellect serves over 500+ customers 
across 62 countries, supported by a global workforce of domain, solution and technology experts. For more 
information about Intellect, visit https://www.intellectdesign.com/ 
 
About IntellectAI 
IntellectAI is an Insurtech Transformation Partner with contemporary AI and ML solutions, data insights 
triangulated from thousands of sources, and agile technology, data science, and consulting teams that take a 
strategic approach to tackling the biggest challenges for the industry. https://www.intellectai.com

MEDIA RELEASE 
TACC Receives Approval Letter for Rs 609.50 Crore 
Incentive under ECMS for its Synthetic Graphite Anode 
Material Project in Dewas 
 
• 
Anode material, a core component of the lithium ion cells that power electric vehicles and 
store clean energy, will be produced at scale in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh. 
• 
The 100+ acre plant is set to produce 20,000 tonnes a year in phase one from June 2027 
• 
A major step towards a Made-in-India battery supply chain for domestic and international 
markets 
Bhopal, November 11, 2026: TACC Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of HEG Advanced Materials 
Limited (HEGAM) and part of the LNJ Bhilwara Group, has received the approval letter for an incentive 
of Rs 609.50 crore under the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS) of the Ministry of 
Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India. The incentive is for TACC’s 
Synthetic Graphite Anode Material project at Sirsoda Industrial Area, Dewas, Madhya Pradesh, and is 
subject to scheme guidelines and prescribed conditions. 
Spread across more than 100 acres, the Dewas facility is planned for a committed scalled capacity of 
beyond 30,000 metric tonnes per annum (MTPA) by FY2028-29. The first phase of 20,000 MTPA is 
targeted for commissioning by June 2027. 
The approval strengthens HEG Advanced Materials’ vision, through its wholly owned subsidiary TACC 
Limited to build localized, resilient and globally competitive battery materials value chain.  It is also a 
significant step towards strengthening India’s advanced energy storage ecosystem. 
Mr. Riju Jhunjhunwala, Chairman, Managing Director and CEO, HEG Advanced Materials Limited, 
said, “We are grateful to the Government of India and the Ministry of Electronics and Information 
Technology for this support, and for their vision of building a strong electronics component 
manufacturing base in the country. The approval under ECMS is a strong endorsement of TACC’s 
technology and of our belief that India can build a globally competitive battery materials value chain 
at home. Anode material sits at the heart of every battery cell, and producing it at scale in India is 
central to a secure and resilient energy storage supply chain.”  
Mr. Ankur Khaitan, Managing Director and CEO, TACC Limited, said, “The support under ECMS 
strengthens our ability to execute at scale. Our Dewas facility is designed to deliver high-
performance synthetic graphite anode material that meets the standards of global cell 
manufacturers. Our focus now is on timely execution, consistent quality and close collaboration with 
customers to ensure supply reliability. We thank the Ministry of Electronics and Information 
Technology for its support.” 
CIN: U31909MP2022PLC064004

 
 
 
About TACC Limited 
TACC Limited, a subsidiary of HEG Advanced Materials, is at the forefront of India’s materials 
innovation, specializing in advanced carbon and graphite technologies. TACC is developing a broad 
range of carbon materials and advanced material solutions to meet the evolving needs of global 
energy storage and diverse industrial applications. In its first phase, TACC will produce 20,000 MT of 
anode active material (AAM) annually, with committed expansion of 44,000 MT catering to global cell 
manufacturers. In parrallel, the company is advancing commercial production of graphene targeting 
500 MT per annum. These efforts are backed by strong in-house R&D and manufacturing capabilities, 
enabling TACC to serve a wide range of high-impact industrial applications. 
About HEG Advanced Materials Limited 
HEG Advanced Materials Limited, a part of the LNJ Bhilwara Group, is a new-age platform spanning 
advanced battery materials and graphene, with a strong manufacturing, R&D and innovation 
foundation, and is also engaged in the business of battery energy solutions and green power. Building 
on HEG’s 50+ years of expertise in graphitisation and manufacturing know-how, the platform is 
developing a large-scale anode materials business, alongside graphene and future material 
development, including silicon-based anodes. Its capabilities span research to revenue, from 
advanced research and product development to commercialisation, serving the evolving EV, BESS 
and energy storage ecosystem. The company is listed on BSE and NSE.

MANAGEMENT: MR. ANIL KUMAR MITTAL – CHAIRMAN AND

KRBL Limited
